Ever Prime Residences — Karon

492 residences across four 8-storey buildings in Karon, with underground parking and 1-, 2- and 4-bedroom layouts. The 4-bedroom format is 176.35 sqm.

An on-site 24-hour Villa Market and café complements the ocean-view rooftop pool and full wellness facilities.

Key facts

  • 492 residences · 4 buildings, 8 floors · 6 rai
  • 1 bedroom 32.89–44.84 sqm
  • 2 bedroom Plus 46.53–60.09 sqm
  • 4 bedroom 176.35 sqm
  • Sea, mountain and city views
  • Underground parking · Completion 2028

Facilities

  • Ocean-view rooftop swimming pool with bar
  • 24-hour Villa Market and café
  • Double lap pools · sauna and steam rooms
  • Fitness centre · yoga studio
  • Business hub and coworking space
  • Beauty salon and nail spa
  • Spa offering Thai massage

The Element — Kamala

Types C, D and E include private-pool layouts, with sizes up to 168.61 sqm.

The Trees Residence — Bangtao

296 residences across the full Bangtao development; 168 of these form the Zone B hotel-managed inventory currently marketed on the official website. Professional services include concierge, housekeeping, room service, laundry, maintenance and shuttle service.

Zone B owners receive 75% of net room income from the managed rental programme and retain unlimited personal use. The leasehold structure is 30 + 30 + 30 years, registered per unit; final contract terms control.

Key facts

  • 296 residences total · 168 marketed in Zone B
  • 1 bedroom 37.28 sqm — from THB 3.99M
  • 2 bedroom 55.03 sqm — from THB 6.05M
  • Leasehold 30 + 30 + 30 years, Land Office registered
  • Professionally hotel-operated
  • 75% of net room income to the owner
  • Unlimited personal use · Completion Q4 2028
  • Bangtao, Cherngtalay, Phuket

Hotel services and location

  • Concierge · housekeeping · room service
  • Laundry · maintenance · shuttle
  • Dedicated Guest Relations Manager
  • Bangtao Beach, Surin Beach, Porto de Phuket, Boat Avenue, Laguna Golf Course and Catch Beach Club all within 10 minutes
  • Phuket International Airport 30 minutes
  • Close to international schools and wellness hubs
